video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | VJ Edgecombe | 10.13.26

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the 76ers' unselfish offensive philosophy
quotes.excerpt: we're just playing unselfish basketball and everyone's just moving, spacing
quotes.quote: I think we're just playing unselfish basketball and everyone's just moving, spacing and I think that's what it is, man. Just being unselfish, playing with no egos, just having fun, being able, we're all just happy to share the floor with one another.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe praises Joel Embiid's two-way impact
quotes.excerpt: defensively, you're going to get Joel Embiid. He's been really good, especially defensively
quotes.quote: He's been great. Like you say, he's on both ends of the floor. Offensively you're going to get Joel Embiid, defensively you're going to get Joel Embiid. He's been really good, especially defensively. What I've seen in the past couple weeks, he's been playing really hard, defending at a high level, and just trying to do his best, protecting the rim and rebounding the ball. He's been great.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the confidence provided by Joel Embiid's rim protection
quotes.excerpt: I got great rim presence behind me and it just even give me more confidence
quotes.quote: It ain't, most of the time it's going to come down to one-on-one and you have to guard your yard, but I know I got great rim presence behind me and it just even give me more confidence when it comes to guarding. I got more confidence now that they might not want to go to the rim, so now it becomes a tougher shot, which we're living with.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on his close relationship with Jared Brown
quotes.excerpt: Jared Brown is one of my favorite people in the world
quotes.quote: Jared Brown is one of my favorite people in the world and he's a great person, someone that I talk to every day. He's a leader, he's just Jared Brown and he's a great person and that's someone that I just have a really good relationship with, even though we just met like two months ago.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on Baron Phylon's confidence and swagger
quotes.excerpt: his confidence is through the roof. Everyone know he plays with such a swagger
quotes.quote: His confidence is through the roof. Everyone know he plays with such a swagger. Obviously we've seen him in college and stuff like that. I played against him in high school. He always had that swagger, he always been confident. I'm just happy to see him on the floor, he's playing really well.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on learning to manipulate offensive players defensively
quotes.excerpt: I just try to learn, see how they try to manipulate the offensive player
quotes.quote: I just pick from everybody. I'm not even just no one in particular that I sit down and just watch, but I watch everybody and I just try to learn, see how they try to manipulate the offensive player. The point of attack defense is most important, gets the defense rolling, so I just try to make sure I'm locked in defensively where it forces us not to rotate as much as we'd want to.
